narr: A predecessor rainfall event resulted in flash flooding across portions of the area as moisture streaming northward ahead of Tropical Storm Elsa encountered a stationary boundary draped across the area. Rainfall amounts ranged 1.5-4 inches, with the ASOS at Teterboro Airport reporting 2.37 inches of rain from this event.
ev: Heavy flooding was reported in Hackensack with cars stuck on roads and multiple water rescues.
All lanes of NJ 17 were closed northbound north of US 46 in Teterboro due to flooding.
The Molly Ann Brook at North Haledon rose above minor flood stage at 2:45pm EST, crested at a height of 6.42 feet at 2:50pm EST, and fell back below flood stage at 3:15pm EST.
